economic_reason: Existing completed-bar, ordinary trade-tape and two-venue threshold families were far below target. This scope tested whether two independently executable leaders agree before Bybit perpetual updates, a structure that could support high capital velocity only if edge survived sub-second latency and full costs.
scope: Fatal upper-bound screen for a distinct same-region three-feed price-discovery mechanism: completed 100ms local-arrival consensus shocks in Binance USDT perpetual and Bybit spot that lead the executable Bybit USDT linear perpetual quote. BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT; 100/250/500ms entry latency; explicit bid/ask, completed same-message signal groups and adverse equal-timestamp execution, top-quote capacity impact, marketable-limit rejection, 12/18/24bp extra round-trip costs; 2023 staged fit/development only and all 2024+ dates sealed.
closure: Zero of 324 candidates survived an impossible future-executable-exit upper-bound gate. The exact Binance-perpetual plus Bybit-spot consensus-lag dependency is retired without threshold, exit, risk or leverage tuning. Reopen only with a materially different information unit such as an algebraically linked synthetic cross-rate or maker-assisted payoff, not an adjacent parameter change.
